children: AIM ImmunoTech completed a series of debt-for-equity exchanges with Streeterville Capital, converting approximately $1,224,341 of its Feb 16 2024 promissory note into 5,065,840 common shares at an average price of about $0.24 per share. The exchanges, executed between Aug 31 and Sep 03 2026, resulted in the note being satisfied in full as of Sep 03 2026. The company previously secured stockholder approval on Jul 15 2026. The transactions eliminate remaining debt and are intended to strengthen the balance sheet.
